items.title: Lighter pauses withdrawals after reported $10M account theft
items.summary: Lighter has paused withdrawals after reporting a leaked trader API key, with Bubblemaps tracking $10.4 million withdrawn.

items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
items.summary: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

items.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border payments to reduce settlement risk
items.summary: Zero-knowledge proofs let each ledger verify the other leg was locked, so neither currency settled unless both did, with no shared ledger or intermediary.

items.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
items.summary: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

items.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack
items.summary: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

items.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
items.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

items.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
items.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

items.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
items.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

items.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
items.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

items.title: Solana drops ‘beta’ label after more than six years
items.summary: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.

items.title: Old crypto feud reignites: Why OKX's Star Xu blames Binance for two years of October crashes
items.summary: CZ says Binance isn’t selling crypto and he has been buying. OKX founder Star Xu accuses him of misleading customers about the exchange’s role in successive October crashes.

items.title: Bitcoin was supposed to gain as AI faltered, but it crashed. Here's why.
items.summary: The price action runs counter to a crypto-market view that a cooling AI trade would trigger a rotation into digital assets and spark a rally.

items.title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near weekend lows as Nasdaq falls more than 1%
items.summary: Strategy and Strive might be the only buyers left in BTC, and each — constrained by weak stock prices — made only modest purchases last week.

items.title: FOMC minutes, Nvidia earnings, Russia’s retail crypto rules: Crypto Week Ahead
items.summary: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 16.

items.title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
items.summary: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin flips to ‘total bull’ on a faster route to quantum-safe Ethereum
items.summary: A proposed system would combine bulky digital signatures into a shared proof, helping protect wallets without making every payment much more expensive.

items.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
items.summary: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

items.title: Cardano holders vote down $5 million bid to buy warehouse copper
items.summary: Toto Finance’s 22 million ADA treasury request expired Sunday with about 20 million ADA in favor, and none of Cardano’s seven constitutional committee members voted yes.

items.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.
